messages:
Olivia CS: Quick heads-up — Wave A (EU) tenant sync hit failures between ~03:02–06:15 UTC. ~25 tenants stalled at the domain-confirmation step due to repeated webhook timeouts. I'm compiling the impacted list in a DM. Need a short customer note + credit plan and priority outreach for high-risk renewals.

IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2026-0473 — EU webhook timeouts affecting onboarding callbacks. Bridge: https://incident.internal.redwood/INC-2026-0473

Rahul Eng: Root cause summary: config drift in LB health-check settings after a Canary change caused upstream pool to mark workers unhealthy under TTL churn. That led to callback requests hitting unhealthy backends -> 504s. Rolling back the health-check change and restarting sync-workers now. ETA ~30m for stabilization.

Ashley Eng: Mitigation applied at 06:45 UTC: reverted health-check patch and restarted workers; reprocessing of backlog started. Observability shows callback 504 spike subsiding, retry queue length decreasing. Sample log spike: ```504 POST /webhook/callback tenant=acct-42 attempts=4```

Keisha Support: CS outreach plan (short): 1) Send targeted message to impacted contacts with plain-English status and next steps. 2) Offer manual assisted confirmation/reschedule or automated reprocess. 3) Offer one-time service credit (TBD amount). I'll draft template and post to #cs-drafts for review.

Devon AM: I'll flag the top 6 renewal-risk accounts and propose an exec outreach + 2-month credit offer where appropriate. Want to avoid surprise on renewal conversations — will coordinate with you, Olivia.

Ari Solutions: We can run two enablement sessions (45m) with EMEA-friendly times Thu/Fri and offer a live walkthrough for any teams that want help verifying DNS/webhook configs. I can join any exec calls. Also prepping a short troubleshooting doc link.

Olivia CS: Please hold on broad broadcast until we confirm final credit amounts and that reprocessing completes. Keisha — can you prepare both an email and an in-app banner variant? Tone: apology, concise timeline, clear options, and next steps.

Keisha Support: Draft ready — posting to #cs-drafts now. Quick template below for review.

Keisha Support: ```
Hi {{first_name}},
We experienced a temporary platform issue on {{date}} that caused onboarding confirmation to be delayed. The issue (now fixed) produced webhook timeouts which stalled some onboarding tasks. We have reprocessed most queues and will prioritize your tenant.
Options: 1) We can assist manually to confirm your domain now, 2) reschedule onboarding at a convenient time, or 3) apply a one-time account credit. Reply with which you prefer and we’ll prioritize.
Sincere apologies for the disruption — Olivia, Customer Success
```

Rahul Eng: Follow-ups for RCA: long-term mitigations will include automated config-drift detection on LB settings, pre-deploy health-check smoke tests, and an auto-fallback routing rule to avoid marking all workers unhealthy during transient churn. I'll draft the technical RCA and attach logs by EOD.

Devon AM: Adding the top accounts to the renewal risk tracker and tagging owners. Will escalate any that request exec-level remediation.

Olivia CS: Last ask — can each owner add a one-line row to the shared sheet (account, mitigation chosen, credit amount, outreach owner) so we can reconcile credits and comms? Sheet: https://docs.internal.redwood/onboard-impact-2026

Rahul Eng: Added infra notes and a log export link to the RCA draft.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0473 status updated: resolved (root cause identified; reprocessing ongoing). Severity: medium-impact during event window.

Ari Solutions: I’ve added suggested session slots to the sheet and will follow up with session invites once CS confirms list.

Olivia CS: Thanks everyone — please watch #cs-drafts for the final copy and tag me when you've updated the sheet. We’ll aim to send first customer messages within the next 2 hours once credits confirmed. :thumbsup:
